{{Quote|If we just had more soldiers of your skill and determination, the Alliance would already have freed the galaxy.|Nitra Vendallan, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Nitra Vendallan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who operated out of the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|C'mon, I'm aging rapidly here. Decision?|Nitra Vendallan, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Nitra Vendallan of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was stationed in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and worked from the local [[Anchorhead Tavern|tavern]]. While there, she learned of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] [[Non-commissioned officer/Legends|non-com]] named [[Drenn Biktor]] who wished to defect to the Alliance. He knew a great deal about Imperial [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] supply routes, which could be useful for the Rebels in interdicting their shipments. Eager to bring Biktor safely to Anchorhead before he could be found by the Empire, Vendallan asked a Rebel [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to escort him.<ref name="SWG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The spacer succeeded in finding Biktor and bringing him back safely to Anchorhead. After returning Biktor, Vendallan made arrangements to get him offworld. However, Vendallan's work did not end there. A friend of hers, named [[Vil Sembian]], son of a famous, deceased [[weaponsmith]] named [[Daw Sembian]], possessed a schematic for a new type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Vil was bringing the schematic to Vendallan, but the Empire was on his tail. Vendallan's [[Commander/Legends|commander]] claimed that the weapon could tip the scales in their favor, so she tasked the same spacer who had helped her earlier with finding and escorting Vil Sembian safely. The Rebel spacer agreed, and succeeded in the mission. Vendallan was pleased, and stated that she would send the schematics to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]].<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nitra Vendallan was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Players who performed a series of quests for Vendallan in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] had to hunt down and escort [[Drenn Biktor]] and [[Vil Sembian]] back to [[City/Legends|town]]. Although the player could choose not to do Nitra Vendallan's quests, this article assumes 100% game completion.<ref name="SWG" />
